YOUR CHECKLIST

Before you start.

  1. Write down the business process and the problem to solve.
  2. Separate essential requirements from preferences.
  3. Confirm users, roles, integrations and data exports.
  4. Compare licence, implementation, hosting and support costs.
  5. Test with representative users and approved sample data.
  6. Agree migration, training, acceptance and exit arrangements.
